title: Malicious SHA-256 file hash db3f5bb77ed3… (OffSeq Mirage)
description: A malicious file identified by the SHA-256 hash db3f5bb77ed357748222aa1dc8cdc30fc12951a615159b81ed6e4ed6c7573273 was observed by OffSeq Mirage honeypot sensors on 2026-11-16. The file was detected 7 times during attacker activity involving the T1105 technique (Ingress Tool Transfer) from attacker infrastructure located in the Netherlands. This hash corresponds to a specific malicious payload that could be a dropper, web shell, miner, or post-exploitation tool. Organizations are advised to check this hash against their environment and security tools to detect potential compromise.
